name: slynk-toolkit
description: Generic, reusable agent skills that empower an engineering workflow. Works with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: slynk
plugins.description: Agent-skills toolkit: spec (stress-test a plan before building), handoff (capture a session for a fresh agent), and create-pr (self-review and open a PR/MR). Skills invoke as slynk:spec, slynk:handoff, and slynk:create-pr.
